Schoenberg positivity makes a negative degree-zero coefficient a necessary obstruction on the fixed sphere. Numerical checker passed 28 supplementary assertions.

originality.rationale: The accessible primary full text treats angular preservation on the circle and affine failure on S2, not fixed-sphere angular failure. Published affine dimension frontiers do not apply to the angular operator. The closest prior angular Hilbert-sphere lifting obstruction does not imply a negative S2 Legendre coefficient, which this theorem computes with a sharp aliasing constant. The searches did not find an equivalent formula; older unindexed analogues remain possible.
